American Bollworm on Cotton.advisory: Monitor cotton fields regularly for boll damage. Remove and destroy affected bolls. Use pheromone traps to track pest activity and consult agricultural officers for integrated pest management measures.

Anthracnose on Cotton.advisory: Avoid water stagnation and ensure proper field drainage. Use certified disease-free seeds and follow recommended crop rotation practices.

Army worm.advisory: Inspect crops during early growth stages. Remove egg masses manually if visible and seek guidance on suitable biological or chemical control methods.

Becterial Blight in Rice.advisory: Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization. Use resistant rice varieties where available and maintain field hygiene to reduce disease spread.

Brownspot.advisory: Maintain balanced fertilization and avoid moisture stress. Early detection and proper nutrient management can reduce disease impact.

Common_Rust.advisory: Remove infected plant residues after harvest. Follow recommended sowing times and use resistant hybrids if available.

Cotton Aphid.advisory: Check the underside of leaves regularly. Encourage natural predators and avoid unnecessary pesticide use.

Flag Smut.advisory: Use certified treated seeds and practice crop rotation. Avoid sowing infected seed material.

Gray_Leaf_Spot.advisory: Ensure proper spacing between plants and remove crop residues after harvest to reduce disease carryover.

Healthy cotton.advisory: The crop appears healthy. Continue standard crop management and pest monitoring practices.

Leaf smut.advisory: Use resistant varieties and ensure proper spacing to reduce humidity within the crop canopy.

Mosaic sugarcane.advisory: Remove infected plants and use healthy planting material. Control insect vectors to prevent spread.

RedRust sugarcane.advisory: Improve field drainage and remove infected leaves. Maintain balanced fertilization.

Wheat aphid.advisory: Encourage natural predators and monitor aphid population levels before taking control measures.

Wheat leaf blight.advisory: Remove crop residues and ensure proper field drainage. Balanced fertilization helps reduce disease severity.
